newsitem.title: USA: Transworld Home names Aitken chairman,CEO.
newsitem.headline: Transworld Home names Aitken chairman,CEO.

text.p: Transworld Home HealthCare Inc said on Wednesday it named Timothy Aitken chairman of the board and chief executive.
Most recently Aitken was vice chairman and president of Apria Healthcare Group Inc.

In May 1996, Joseph Raymond said he would resign as chief executive and step down as chairman in mid-August. Robert Fine, the company's president, was acting chief executive while the company searched for a replacement.
Transworld Home provides alternate site health-care products and services. The company also operates a specialized mail-order pharmacy and provides medical supplies.
